evidence.quote: at its August 2011 meeting the Committee elaborated by indicating that it anticipated rates would remain low at least through mid-2013.
In more normal times, when short-term policy rates are not constrained, I expect that balance sheet policies will be rarely used.
The evolving consensus, which is by no means settled, is that monetary policy is too blunt a tool to be routinely used to address possible financial imbalances
The FOMC continues to explore ways to further increase transparency about its forecasts and policy plans.

parsed.rationale: The speech is a retrospective on central bank frameworks, tools and financial stability with no current outlook assessment, though it describes existing low-rate guidance and asset purchases in an accommodative context. It carries a near-neutral, slightly dovish net signal.
